SRB.Settings.Language.Name: Language
SRB.Settings.Language.Hint: Choose whether Roll Breakdown follows Foundry or uses a fixed module language.
SRB.Settings.Enabled.Name: Enable roll breakdowns
SRB.Settings.Enabled.Hint: Add the breakdown panel to eligible chat messages on this client.
SRB.Settings.DefaultExpanded.Name: Expanded by default
SRB.Settings.DefaultExpanded.Hint: Open the breakdown panel automatically for new eligible messages.
SRB.Settings.Visibility.Name: Breakdown visibility
SRB.Settings.Visibility.Hint: Choose who sees the breakdown panel. Owners are players who made the roll or own the speaking actor. GMs always see it.
SRB.Settings.HideNpcRolls.Name: Hide NPC and GM rolls from players
SRB.Settings.HideNpcRolls.Hint: Players get no panel on rolls from actors that no player owns or on GM rolls without a player owned speaker. This keeps monster bonuses secret.
SRB.Settings.ShowUnknown.Name: Show unknown terms
SRB.Settings.ShowUnknown.Hint: Display unresolved or unlabeled formula terms instead of hiding them.
SRB.Settings.Debug.Name: Debug logging
SRB.Settings.Debug.Hint: Write roll breakdown decisions and parser details to the browser console.
